correctness.rationale: A self-contained reduction via the group-algebra identity C(Sn)-C(S2)-C(Sn−2), central transposition content eigenvalues, and multiplicity-free Pieri two-box branching gives every needed eigenvalue. All legal corner removals of the two specified diagrams are enumerated, determining the exact maxima and hence both minima. Dominance and vertex-connectivity are checked directly. Exact parameter evaluations 6≤n≤20, and independent explicit seminormal matrix Laplacian diagonalization for 6≤n≤10, reproduce them. This is a general algebraic proof, not inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: The 2026 2/3 conjecture is motivated by interchange mixing, and its known exact sharpness example is a star with a cut vertex. Whether removing the obvious graph-theoretic degeneracy could improve the comparison constant is a natural structural boundary. The result rules out every strictly larger size-independent constant even among 2-vertex-connected, bipartite simple graphs; it is not a routine restatement of the original star example. Its precise spectra exhibit the asymptotic approach and parity correction.
